fusions.name: Couched at the Gallop
fusions.desc: You couch the staff and rush an enemy up to 8 tiles away, dealing 12 damage, up to 1.6 times that the further the blow travels.

fusions.name: Trampling Arc
fusions.desc: You sweep the staff low at hoof height through a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 7 damage to everything in it. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Second Saddle Wind
fusions.desc: You settle into a long-ridden rhythm on the staff, and your stamina recovery rises 50% for 18 seconds.

fusions.name: Leans and Keeps Going
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you lean on the staff and regain 4 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
